name: Margot-Edith Villa Avalon
original_name: マーゴット＝エディス・ヴィラ・アヴァロン
source:
An honest and good girl. She is the de facto crown princess because her eyes are a "noble violet" color, which is proof that she should have the throne. Although she looks a lot like the former empress Ursula, she has a much kinder personality.

She was secretly moved to the "Cape Mansion" because she was a target from the moment she was born. There, she was raised by Erin. She worries about finally returning to the Imperial City for the first time in 12 years, reuniting with her father, and about becoming the next empress.

[Translated from [url=http://sugar.f-sp.net/]official website[/url]]
